commands_raw:
$if !talkedSitri {
    Morgan
    ---
    You're awake
    ---
    Have you forgotten the time?
    ---
    Get your fishing rod ready and begin fishing
    ---
    signal(set,talkedSitri,true)
    ?> Have you found the seal? -> useful
}
$else {
    Throw, listen, wait, pull. A ritual, like everything else we do
    -> choices
}
name: start

commands_raw:
You think you're the only one daydreaming on the job?
---
I haven't found anything either
---
-> choices
name: useful

commands_raw:
The rod in your hands! Cast it into the void below. 
---
When you hear the splash, it's found the water. Wait.. ten to fifteen heartbeats. 
---
Then you'll notice a red spark on the castline. 
---
It bites... Pull it - let it struggle, but it knows that it will eventually become prey.
---
-> choices
name: remind

commands_raw:
Good to hear. Whisper to Marbas behind me, he will trade us their remains. 
---
Keep fishing. Until we've found the seal.
---
-> choices
name: caught

commands_raw:
?> I've caught some fish -> caught
?> Could you remind me how to fish? -> remind
?> Leave
name: choices
